part.text:
Fixed. The issue was in `modules/caddyhttp/ip_matchers.go`: `MatchRemoteIP.UnmarshalCaddyfile` and `MatchClientIP.UnmarshalCaddyfile` each consumed only the first matcher-name token (`d.Next()` once), so when a `not` block contains multiple `client_ip`/`remote_ip` lines, the later segments' ranges were silently dropped (a single-instance matcher was AND'd instead of merged).

The change loops `for d.Next()` over all repeated matcher segments (same pattern `MatchNot` already uses), merging all ranges into one matcher. Verified:
- `go test ./modules/caddyhttp/ ./caddyconfig/httpcaddyfile/` all pass
- An end-to-end adapter test with the issue's exact `not { client_ip ... } x3` config now yields a single `client_ip` matcher with all 5 ranges merged (temporary harness, since removed)
